{
  "name": "kittex",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Shows the LaTeX math in Claude's replies as real equations: images in kitty and Ghostty, text elsewhere",
  "author": {
    "name": "Breno Cunha Queiroz"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/brenocq/kittex",
  "repository": "https://github.com/brenocq/kittex",
  "keywords": [
    "latex",
    "math",
    "mathjax",
    "equations",
    "typesetting",
    "kitty",
    "ghostty",
    "terminal",
    "unicode"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "block": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Block math",
      "description": "Equations on their own line ($$…$$): image (typeset; Unicode in terminals without images), unicode (Unicode text) or raw (Claude's LaTeX as written).",
      "options": [
        "image",
        "unicode",
        "raw"
      ],
      "default": "image"
    },
    "inline": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Inline math",
      "description": "Math inside a sentence ($…$): image, unicode or raw (same meanings).",
      "options": [
        "image",
        "unicode",
        "raw"
      ],
      "default": "image"
    },
    "latex": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Local LaTeX",
      "description": "Diagrams (TikZ, pgfplots, chemfig…) and math MathJax can't render: auto (drawn with your TeX install where one is found) or off (TeX never runs; diagrams stay code blocks).",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "cache": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cache equation images",
      "description": "Keep rendered equations on disk (~/.cache/kittex by default) so resumed sessions draw them instantly: on or off.",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "on"
    }
  }
}
